headline: 新片冷清日，英雄热榜时
headlineEn: Quiet day for new releases, heroes heat up charts
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅3部新片。热搜由《绿灯军团》《玩具总动员5》《奥德赛》等领衔，超级英雄与动画IP强势霸榜，市场静待下一波重点档期。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today; only 3 open this week. Trending is led by Green Lantern Corps, Toy Story 5, and The Odyssey, with superhero and animation franchises dominating the charts.

industryHighlights.en: Three new movies in total this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》登顶今日与本周双榜
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps tops both today's and weekly charts.

industryHighlights.text: 超级英雄与动画IP持续占据主流关注
industryHighlights.en: Superhero and animated IP continue to dominate attention.

industryHighlights.text: 暂无值得注意的即将上映项目
